sourceReview.scope: Current unofficial client model, private local-app draft/editor/processor, account-and-backend-scoped device-local app setup persistence, retained card compatibility, optional app-declared OCR, and browser/native handoff consumers. This scope does not enable or require new backend canisters.
exclusions: Historical PR1/PR2 inventories and advisory decisions are preserved separately, not accepted as current source snapshots.
Core authentication, chat, wallet, media, generic compiler/minifier/style dependencies and unrelated plugins are not selected by mixed-file coexistence.
Mixed entrypoints and build hooks have exact feature ownership anchors; only dedicated feature modules undergo direct-import scanning.

The mixed OpenChat client is anchored only for the private-app backend scope getter reached by the workspace. Its complete file fingerprint detects drift; unrelated core imports are not scanned or selected as feature roots.
Private drafts are memory-only. The idb root covers retained action-card cache reconciliation, not new draft storage or remote pre-review verification.

Private app setup persistence uses the browser IndexedDB API and existing local catalog, processor-hash and Web Crypto helpers, not a new npm or Rust dependency. Only explicitly imported setup, selection and chat opt-ins are saved; messages, drafts, approvals and handoff payloads are excluded.
Source ownership is not advisory, runtime, image-accuracy, phone, deployment or release acceptance.
